rationale: This study is an epidemiological investigation of diarrheal disease risk in rural Matlab, Bangladesh. Even if household water or sanitation conditions are implicitly among the environmental factors analyzed, the exposure set is explicitly limited to biological, socioeconomic, cultural/behavioral and environmental factors (failing Criterion 2 under both readings, E03), and the outcome is diarrheal disease risk rather than water or sanitation service access (also failing Criterion 4).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow rule-type reading and the plain literal reading of Criterion 2 because the study is a spatial-temporal epidemiological analysis of biological, socioeconomic, cultural/behavioral and environmental risk factors for diarrheal disease, with no legal, administrative, regulatory, institutional or governance mechanism and no water or sanitation service-access outcome.

evidence_quotes.quote: Diarrheal disease risk in Matlab, Bangladesh
The objective of this research project is to assess risk for diarrheal disease in rural Bangladesh
analyzing the complex and dynamic interaction of biological, socioeconomic, cultural/behavioral and environmental factors over time and space.
